item.title: CollectWise (YC F24) Is Hiring
item.description:

item.title: RotaryCell: Making an unmodified rotary phone work over LTE with an ESP32-S3
item.description:
📝 RotaryCell RotaryCell converts a traditional rotary telephone into a self-contained, battery-powered, portable cellular telephone without modifying the original telephone. net For a hand-wired build, start with the complete prototype wiring reference. Important cautions Never connect prototype Tip/Ring wiring or the repurposed charging jack to the public telephone network or energized premises telephone wiring.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/fregacmols/RotaryCell
